scope: Authoritative supported performance selections. Application ingress flags are additionally inventoried from their parser declarations; research-only flags are explicitly non-selectable here.

features.name: performance-runtime
features.description: Use the ordinary engine selection or the exact verified native template against current project sources.

features.name: render-thread
features.description: Select engine render-thread policy; actual thread IDs are observed independently.

features.name: drive-collision
features.description: Choose the actual collision owner before opening a World.

features.name: drive-height-plan
features.description: Build the original WOK face-order height lookup on a worker after the terrain is ready. Explicit selection only; the accepted path stays off.

features.name: drive-preview-height-index
features.description: Opt into the original-WOK high-face movement-preview height index. Low-face tiles and normal gameplay retain the accepted direct route.

features.name: drive-preview-worker
features.description: Run blocked movement preview search on a sealed collision snapshot in one bounded worker. The synchronous route remains the default until normal-client acceptance.

features.name: drive-preview-surface-cache
features.description: Reuse detached tile, mesh and table data for the optional blocked movement preview worker. Off preserves the uncached packet path.

features.name: light-input-registry
features.description: Use script collection or the native registry capability. Explicit unavailable native selection rejects.

features.name: world-snapshot-preparation
features.description: Prepare immutable area snapshot data in script or owned workers; actual worker dispatch/use and lifecycle are reported separately.

features.name: world-snapshot-verified-packet
features.description: Use worker-verified snapshot metadata packets, or explicitly restore complete main-thread validation. Only relevant when snapshot workers are selected.

features.name: entry-commit
features.description: Use bounded new-area world commitment, or explicitly select the original synchronous commit for matched validation and rollback.

features.name: entry-commit-budget
features.description: Bound each staged new-area commit frame to 4, 6, or 8 milliseconds. The 4 ms accepted setting remains the default; larger slices are private loading-latency experiments.

features.name: binary-clips
features.description: Use the bounded parallel parser for eligible original binary MDL clips. The ordinary path remains off until original-entry acceptance.

features.name: detailed-profiling
features.description: Explicit profiling policy for matched tests; saved retains the user preference. Actual enabled state is observed.

features.name: loading-pipeline
features.description: Named loading family. It does not select a faster engine, render thread, light registry or collision owner.

features.name: shared-animation-preparation
features.description: Worker preparation sharing; private runtime poses remain private.

features.name: native-draw-cache
features.description: Optional converted static-model geometry files, produced on demand.

features.name: native-draw-cache-gib
features.description: Committed converted-geometry payload limit in GiB; no up-front allocation.

features.name: base-scenery-owner
features.description: BASE object preparation owner; selected through the loading pipeline.

features.name: base-scenery-templates
features.description: Reuse source templates in the retained BASE owner.

features.name: base-scenery-template-probe
features.description: Allow ready preparation hits past cold jobs.

features.name: base-scenery-admission
features.description: Optional time-bounded BASE admission.

features.name: base-scenery-stream
features.description: Continuously replenish bounded player-centric reservations.

features.name: model-template
features.description: PackedScene or known-property model construction, with explicit unsupported-graph fallback.

features.name: static-scenery
features.description: Terrain batching selection; exact eligible geometry only.

features.name: base-scenery-draw
features.description: Verified immutable BASE draw-leaf merging.

features.name: render-profile
features.description: Existing lighting and particle presentation bundle. Isolated test defaults may differ.

features.name: native-runtime
features.description: Existing editor or packaged release route, used when performance-runtime is standard.

features.name: native-lighting
features.description: Existing lighting selection; explicit individual overrides are recorded as custom.

features.name: native-light-history
features.description: Original light-selection/history policy.

features.name: native-surface-output
features.description: Native surface color-transfer path.

features.name: particle-presentation
features.description: Existing particle presentation route.

features.name: particle-animation-snapshot
features.description: Opt-in frame-local particle animation input snapshot for the shared native presentation route.

features.name: particle-lighting
features.description: Existing particle light ownership.

features.name: native-overhead-clocks
features.description: Live overhead clock handling; offline replay has a separate policy.

features.name: profile
features.description: Native output of detailed-profiling or the existing native-profile switch; saved preference otherwise applies.

researchOnly.name: particle-random
researchOnly.reason: V4 used native selection and a different pinned particle DLL. Normal-launch support/capabilities must be proven separately.

researchOnly.name: particle-clocks
researchOnly.reason: V4 used native clocks; copying a flag is not proof the current kernel implements it.

researchOnly.name: particle-pose-leases
researchOnly.reason: V4 selected managed leases. Current-source and kernel parity must be verified before normal forwarding.

researchOnly.name: highlight
researchOnly.reason: V4 selected whole-character; ordinary host currently does not expose this option.

normalGameplayDefaults.scope: Applied by the ordinary launcher only; explicit selections win. Base feature defaults remain the direct/isolated/conservative policy.
normalGameplayDefaults.acceptedRenderCore: Accepted combined-b normal bundle; diagnostic timers OFF and explicit conservative selections preserved.

acceptedNativeBundle.optionalTypedInput: Explicit script input omits typed and segmented readers
acceptedNativeBundle.fallback: Explicit standard/editor/release and isolated routes retain no implicit bundle flags; accepted DLL flag-absent paths preserve conservative behavior
acceptedNativeBundle.scope: Combined resident text borrowing and immutable empty-clip lookup skip; private normal integration acceptance remains separately receipted.
